headline: ASML comments indicate AI infrastructure build-out continues
summary: ASML management indicated in recent comments that the ongoing artificial intelligence infrastructure build-out shows no signs of slowing down.
why: ASML is a critical Dutch multinational corporation that supplies essential photolithography systems used by major global semiconductor manufacturers.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Positive demand outlooks from key equipment suppliers boost sector-wide confidence for chipmakers.
